body.x: NEHEARA, unveiled its a noise cancellation earphone ‘IQBUDS’ at ‘CES 2018 Unveiled’ held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. on Sunday, Jan. 7th.

IQBUDS is an earphone that blocks the surrounding noise and amplifies the necessary sounds to user. With smart phone app, the user can configure the detailed noise cancellation setting, and can use up to maximum 4 hours on one full charge. It has stereo sound, hands-free and Bluetooth functions. IQBUDS helps people around the world listen o what they want to hear and connect to digital devices.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
